acceptance_criterion: The current status is shown on the event detail screen for every user permitted to view the event
test_name: shows the organiser the status and every change on their own event, oldest first (AC1, AC2, AC4)

acceptance_criterion: Internal roles (Event Organiser for their own event, assigned Event Coordinator, and Event Coordinators generally) can see the full status history
test_name: shows Event Coordinators generally the full history, assigned or not (AC2)

acceptance_criterion: Attendees see the current status only, and never the history, review comments, or rejection reasons
test_name: never gives an attendee the history, and gives no event data at all outside their scope (AC3)

acceptance_criterion: History entries are listed in chronological order and each shows previous status, new status, acting user's role, and timestamp
test_name: lists entries by time even when they were stored out of order (AC4)

acceptance_criterion: History entries are listed in chronological order and each shows previous status, new status, acting user's role, and timestamp
test_name: shows the organiser every change on their request, oldest first, with both statuses, the role and the time

acceptance_criterion: History entries cannot be edited or deleted from any screen
test_name: offers no way to change a history entry (AC5)

acceptance_criterion: History entries cannot be edited or deleted from any screen
test_name: offers no control that edits or deletes an entry
